profile.highSchoolName: Big Horn County High School (rural Wyoming public)

awards.name: Wyoming Governor's Scholar (top student from rural counties)

rationale.intuition: Stanford explicitly recruits 'first from HS', rural, and underrepresented geographic applicants — Stanford CDS does not publish but admissions blog 'Why We Care About Where You Live' confirms rural & first-gen receive contextual lift (estimated 1.3-1.6× per Espenshade/AP). Wyoming applicants face structural disadvantage (no AP courses, weak placement record) but Stanford reads in context. 真实 industry 区间 5-15%. Engine 当前 isFirstGen 已经给 ~1.4× boost (modifier 已实现), 但 'rural HS / first from HS' 维度不在 ProfileInput — engine 看不到 'no AP available' vs 'didn't take APs'. Confidence medium 反映 SAT 1480 (低于 Stanford middle 50 1510-1580) + 缺 AP 信号的真实不确定性.

sources.name: Stanford Admissions Blog - 'Why We Care About Where You Live' 2022
sources.evidence: 'Applicants from underrepresented zip codes — especially rural areas where Stanford recruits actively — are read in the context of their school's offerings, not against a fixed AP-count benchmark'

sources.name: Espenshade & Radford 'No Longer Separate, Not Yet Equal' 2009
sources.evidence: Rural & first-gen applicants at T20 receive 1.3-1.6× admit lift over urban suburban peers with equivalent stats; effect persists post-2014 cohorts

sources.name: Stanford Class of 2028 Profile
sources.evidence: ~9% from rural communities; ~17% first-gen; both populations underrepresented in applicant pool → higher per-application admit rate (~6-9%)

wontFix.reason: Engine does not model HS-context signals beyond isFirstGen — 'first from HS to apply', rural zip code, HS resources, AP offerings count are not in ProfileInput. Stanford's well-documented rural recruiting effect is invisible to engine. Profile 的 highSchoolRecognition=1 / tier=4 currently produces neutral 1.0× (clamp [1.0, 1.04]) rather than reflecting CONTEXTUAL POSITIVE for rural.
wontFix.followUp: Add ruralHs / firstFromHs / hsResourceTier signals + invert highSchoolContextComponent to allow context-lift (not just feeder-lift). Distinct from fixtures 096/097 which need feeder-lift; this fixture needs context-lift.
